request.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a transparent full-body landmark character group for the established Canran children's English learning journey map, Lesson 9–10.
Input images in exact order: Image 1 is the approved world visual master, use only its warm storybook art direction and friendly small landmark scale; do not recreate the UI or environment. Image 2 is the precise character rendering and body-proportion master: thick clean warm-brown outlines, round large heads, compact short bodies, rounded hands and shoes, soft shaded volume, warm cheerful faces. Images 3 and 4 are identity, clothing, age, and greeting-pose references only for Steven and Helen; do NOT inherit their tall slender body proportions or their background.
Primary request: Create exactly two complete adult neighbors greeting each other. Steven on the left: mature silver-gray curly hair visible beneath a moss-green flat cap, forest-green jacket, cream shirt, warm-brown trousers and brown shoes. Helen on the right: straight black bob hair with blunt bangs, plum-purple long coat, cream dress, blue handbag with a small gold clasp, brown shoes. Preserve their recognizable mature identities, but redraw both with approximately three-heads-tall, round-headed compact proportions matching Image 2 closely. They turn slightly toward one another, each lifts an open hand in a friendly greeting, with warm smiles. Steven may keep the other hand relaxed near his pocket; Helen holds or carries her blue handbag on the other forearm. Keep all hands clearly readable and anatomically simple.
Style/medium: polished warm children's storybook cartoon; thick confident dark warm-brown outline, smooth softly shaded color surfaces, gentle cream highlights and warm shadows, friendly rounded forms, subtle texture only. Match Image 2's finish and scale, not a sketch, watercolor wash, photorealistic adult, 3D plastic toy, anime, or flat thin-line vector.
Composition/framing: one cohesive centered two-person group in a square canvas approximately 1254x1254. Full bodies head to toe, complete caps, hair, arms, hands, handbag, dress hems and shoes. Both feet rest on the same clear horizontal ground baseline. Figures occupy about 78–82% of canvas height with 8–12% fully transparent safe margins around the complete group. Leave a modest natural gap between the two neighbors; no overlapping faces or hands.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha background, absolutely no scenic background, no baked-in street corner, no railing, tree, architecture, floor, platform, pedestal or ground shadow. Only the two characters and Helen's handbag.
Constraints: exactly Steven and Helen, no additional people, no Tony or Emma, no decorative objects or floating effects. No text, letters, numbers, lesson labels, UI, badges, medallions, stars, circles, glow, borders or watermark. Preserve complete silhouettes with transparent padding on every edge.

references.role: precise character rendering and compact body proportions
Steven and Helen identities and clothing
Steven and Helen full-body identities and greeting poses

preservation: Preserve native generated PNG and genuine alpha. WebP encoding only; no crop, resizing, recoloring, extraction or programmatic image editing.
